stories.title: Ed Sheeran addresses Gaza after dropping Macklemore from tour
new_facts: Sheeran addresses Gaza directly on stage, calling the situation 'catastrophic and unjustifiable'.
Sheeran tears up, says 'I cannot hide how I feel...anymore', reversing prior no-politics stance.
Sheeran apologizes on stage for 'making mistakes' regarding the tour controversy.
Publishes full text of Sheeran's pre-concert speech addressing Gaza controversy.
Sheeran quoted: 'My heart has been broken by the scale of devastation and loss of civilians' lives, of children's lives.'
Pro-Palestinian protesters gathered outside Sheeran's Philadelphia concert, waving flags and chanting.
stories.line: Ed Sheeran addressed Gaza criticism at a concert after another artist was dropped from his tour over Israel-Palestine statements.

stories.title: South Korea reports mixed economic and environmental indicators
stories.line: South Korea's greenhouse emissions fell slightly while online banks increased lending to small businesses and immigration from Vietnam accelerated.

stories.title: Studies link exercise, sleep duration, and pollution to health outcomes
stories.line: Recent studies link slow running to better thinking, long sleep to higher mortality risk, and air pollution to eye disease.

stories.title: Police warn of potential AI-powered drone threats
new_facts: Police Executive Research Forum warns AI advances and cheap drones threaten US cities.
stories.line: Police groups warn that AI-powered drones could be weaponized; no concrete evidence yet of imminent threat.

stories.title: South Korea wins first medals at Asian Games
new_facts: Pentathlete Seong Seung-min won South Korea's first gold medal at the Asian Games.
Cyclist Shin Ji-eun won bronze, South Korea's first medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.
stories.line: South Korean athletes win their first medals at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

stories.title: California fines influencers for undisclosed paid political posts
new_facts: Newsom signs law fining influencers up to $5,000 per post for undisclosed paid political content.
Newsom signs package of election-security bills making ballot/record interference illegal, aimed at Trump interference.
Election security package also extends hours for mail-in ballot drop-off locations.
stories.line: California imposes fines up to $5,000 per post on influencers who fail to disclose paid political content.
